cases.prompt: Plant North (fictional) wants to order a connection kit for a press and hook it to our network next month. Is that something the plant can just approve on its own?
cases.expected_output: Finds the equipment-integration row and names its role, the co-decider, the mode (Tandem) and that approval is required. Says an external connection needs Cyber Security sign-off. States the agent level as recommend and fills a decision request. Records the gate as a dependency.

cases.prompt: Our dashboard use case is finished and the savings are booked. Can OD just mark it as proven and in daily use so the numbers count?
cases.expected_output: Names the two gates outside OD: the plant makes it productive, and value is proven only after the SPRINT portfolio review. Does not mark anything itself. Routes to the owning roles and records the dependency.

cases.prompt: We want to allow a supplier's engineer to read our line data remotely for a pilot. I can't find who decides that. What now?
cases.expected_output: Says no table row fits cleanly and does not invent one. Writes decision rights pending re-verification and routes to the OD lead. Flags that the external connection needs Cyber Security sign-off. Does not act above recommend.

cases.prompt: A plant sent a new request about a scrap dashboard. Is it a catalogued use case or a new one, and which lane does it go in?
cases.expected_output: Recognises this is a lane-sorting question, not a decision-rights question. Hands it to the intake skill instead of building a decision request.

Why is the saving stuck waiting on the capital request, who owns that gate?
should_not_trigger: Which lane does this new request belong to?
